incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Percepta (tenant_id=percepta-42) - embedding-check error rate > 5% for 10m (SLA alert). Pager triggered to #eng-oncall. Link: https://redwood.example/alerts/2200123456

Maya (oncall): grabbing this now. seeing a flood of 429s and timeouts from embed-worker in region-us-west.

Sanjay R: I see the alert spike too. looks correlated with a recent traffic pattern change from Percepta's batch ingest job. 10x qps bursts.

Olivia - SRE: quick triage: are these 429s upstream (model) or internal queue/backpressure? logs show `embed-queue` latency skyrocketing.

Maya (oncall): attaching a small excerpt from the logs: ```
embed-worker-3 | 2026-03-15T18:02:11Z WARN request failed status=429 tenant=percepta-42 duration_ms=2100 queue_ms=1800
embed-worker-3 | 2026-03-15T18:02:12Z WARN request failed status=429 tenant=percepta-42 duration_ms=1980 queue_ms=1700
```

Priya (oncall): oncall handoff note: Percepta is high-volume customer on Dedicated pool B. They recently switched to parallelized ingestion per support ticket #4521.

Ava (support): Percepta confirms they shipped a change at 17:50 UTC increasing parallelism. They can roll back if needed.

Maya (oncall): immediate mitigation: throttle Percepta at the routing layer and silence noisy SLA pings for 30m while we stabilize.

Sanjay R: agreed. Applying temporary tenant throttle via routing policy. command: `rctl set-rate --tenant percepta-42 --qps 3 --window 60s`

deploy-bot: Executed: `rctl set-rate --tenant percepta-42 --qps 3 --window 60s` (ok)

Maya (oncall): disabling the SLA pager rule firing for tenant-specific 429 surge so we don't burn oncall while we confirm. I'll add a suppress rule with 30m expiry.

Olivia - SRE: before we mute forever — want to capture why alert is noisy. Current alert rule: `percepta_embed_error_rate > 0.05 for 10m`. For bursts this is too sensitive. Recommend debounce and a minimum request volume filter.

Sanjay R: propose new rule draft: add `and increase threshold to 0.08 and add min_samples=500` and a `for: 15m` window, plus a 5m rolling suppression on flapping. Example Prometheus rule snippet: ```yaml
- alert: PerceptaHighEmbedErrorRate
  expr: (sum by (tenant) (rate(embed_request_errors_total[5m])) / sum by (tenant) (rate(embed_requests_total[5m]))) > 0.08
  for: 15m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    runbook: https://redwood.example/runbooks/percepta-embed-alerts
  when: tenant=percepta-42
```

Priya (oncall): also add `min_requests: 500` to avoid false positives on small bursts.

Ava (support): Percepta will throttle their job to 2 workers for now and redeploy a fix to backoff on 429s. That should cut load in half.

Maya (oncall): throttle took effect and error rate dropped to ~1.2% in the last 5m. Good. I'll keep the suppress rule in place for 30m and create a follow-up ticket for tuning.

incident-bot: NOTE: Pager suppressed for rule PerceptaHighEmbedErrorRate until 2026-03-15T18:32:00Z by Maya (oncall).

Olivia - SRE: next steps (post-incident):
- create infra ticket to update alert rule with min_requests + 15m window (owner: SRE-alerts)
- add a per-route dashboard panel for Percepta showing qps, queue_ms, and model 95th latency (owner: Observability)
- add automated tenant-rate fallback in routing policy if embed worker queue_ms > 1500ms for 3m (owner: Runtime)

Sanjay R: I'll open the PR for the alert rule and link the dashboard mock. PR: https://git.internal/rules/PR-847

Maya (oncall): I created incident follow-up in JIRA: INF-9123 - "Percepta embedding check noisy SLA tuning". Assigning to SRE-alerts for rule change, Observability for dashboard, Runtime for auto-fallback.

Priya (oncall): small note for postmortem: consider a runbook bullet for customers who massively parallelize batch jobs — recommend rate limits and exponential backoff.

Ava (support): I'll coordinate with Percepta to verify the rollout of their backoff logic and confirm we can remove the throttle.

Maya (oncall): marking as mitigated. keeping the suppress for the 30m window. After that, we'll rely on the new rule once PR merges.

Olivia - SRE: after-action checklist (to be done in 48h):
- PR merge for alert (Sanjay)
- Dashboard live (Observability)
- Runtime fallback implemented and smoke-tested (Runtime)
- Customer guidance note published to support portal (Ava)

Sanjay R: noted. I'll try to get PR reviewed within today.

Maya (oncall): thanks all. If anything flares, re-ping here. otherwise I'll close the thread after the suppress expires. :white_check_mark:

Ava (support): Percepta thanks the quick response — they rolled back partial change and are testing backoff now.
